correctness.rationale: The transfer matrix appends either bit with its Bernoulli weight and marks exactly the off-diagonal transitions. Its trace and determinant are 1 and r(1−z²). Cayley–Hamilton gives the two-step recurrence; the continuant formula follows from two initial values. For z=it, t≠0, vanishing would force two consecutive continuants to vanish at s=r(1+t²)>0, impossible by backward iteration. At z=0 the constant coefficient is p^n+(1−p)^n>0. An alternating word has positive probability, so degree n−1 cannot drop along any compact p-path from 1/2. At that point XOR differences are independent fair bits, so continuity and no boundary zeros give strict left-half-plane location. Negative real roots and conjugate pairs give normalized linear or quadratic positive probability factors. For sharpness, both changes in a triple occur only on 010 or 101, of total probability r; hence adjacent indicator covariance is r−4r². Nonadjacent indicators are independent. An independent Bernoulli representation must contain precisely n−1 nondegenerate factors by the support endpoints and has variance at most μ−μ²/(n−1), below the actual variance for n≥3 and biased p. The fair and n=2 exceptions are as stated. Separately reproduced the means and variances by rational binary-word enumeration for n=2–7 at p=1/3, and checked the Ising alias below at 120 rational parameter/argument choices by independent enumeration of the bit and edge words; the all-parameter conclusions use the analytic arguments. The frozen diagnostic script was inspected, not executed.

Write σ_j for the independent spins, b=|1−2p|, x=(1−z)/(1+z). For each edge z^{1_{σ_j≠σ_{j+1}}}=((1+z)/2)(1+x σ_jσ_{j+1}). Expand in the selected-edge indicators e_1,…,e_{n−1}. Spins of odd selected degree contribute their common mean; the number of these is even and equals e_1+e_{n−1}+sum |e_{k+1}−e_k|. Thus Z(z)=((1+z)/2)^(n−1) times the ferromagnetic Ising partition function on the edge path, with disagreement weight b and activities x inside, bx at each endpoint (b²x in a path with just one vertex).
Kim's periodic Potts trace formulation in Eq. (4) is not this open-path vertex-activity representation.

value.rationale: The distinction between an oriented pattern and the aggregate is a natural question, and the continuant proof is useful exposition. But the main positive result follows by the classical expansion and strict Lee–Yang theorem; the exact index left over is a short support-and-variance deduction using only triple probabilities. No new quantitative zero invariant, stronger classification, or independently valuable remainder is established in the frozen result.
